reproduction_target: Spatially-explicit forward population-genetic simulation of mito-nuclear discordance under sex-biased dispersal: a non-Wright-Fisher SLiM v4.0.1 model (SCRIPT_MITONUCLEAR.slim; 2D 1x1 landscape, K=20000, ten 160kb nuclear fragments + one 16kb maternally-inherited mitochondrial segment, mu_nuc=1e-8, mu_mt=1e-7, r_nuc=1e-8, r_mt=0, 100'000 generations x 10 seeded replicates) across NBD + 6 sex-biased dispersal scenarios (FBD/MBD x dispersal multipliers), followed by a Python/Jupyter analysis notebook (Correlation_Github.ipynb) that samples 100 individuals every 200 generations and computes Pearson correlations among nuclear diversity, mitochondrial diversity, and geometric distance (nu-geo, mt-geo, nu-mt).
